name: Sam Moore
learned: Sam Moore is Jennifer Moore's father. A sound specialist who formed a Performance Team with Andrew Williams and David Evans and remains very close to them. His climate-change conviction is very low and dismissive: he tends to see climate change as exaggerated or largely driven by natural variability, and he does not view it as an urgent, existential threat requiring immediate systemic intervention—often implying that the problem is either overstated or effectively out of ordinary people’s hands. His institutional trust is low: he assumes government climate communication and policy are politicized, shaped by vested interests, and unlikely to be transparent or accountable, expecting more symbolism than effective delivery. This combination makes him an apathetic cynic—disengaged from climate urgency and skeptical that institutions can or will manage the issue in a credible, competent way.
